description.value: Harper Mountain is a family-owned ski hill that has operated since 1973, sitting just 20 minutes from Kamloops with 1,400 vertical feet of terrain across more than 400 acres. The mountain centres on a cozy log day lodge with a large wood fireplace and a licensed hot-food cafeteria, offering skiing, snowboarding, snowshoeing, a terrain park, night skiing, and lift-operated snow tubing. An Enduro race is listed among the mountain's resources and a Summer Rentals section appears in the site navigation, hinting at warm-season activity that may appeal to mountain bikers.
